For import from file directory, please use relative path to Magento installation, e.g. var/import.
You can also import files and images using links. To do this, please specify the links to the files in the import file. Please, note that if you import files using links, the files are temporarily stored in the Import Files Directory during the import process, so this field should be filled in.
Please note that when you import an image with the same name that already exists in the system, then the image will be updated.
